record.context_brief: maximal number of relations in symmetric semigroups
record.original_question: For each positive integer e, let S(e) be the supremum of rho(Gamma) over all symmetric numerical semigroups Gamma with embedding dimension edim(Gamma) = e, where a numerical semigroup is symmetric when for every integer x not in Gamma one has Frob(Gamma) - x in Gamma. Determine S(e).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Gamma \subseteq \mathbb{N}$ be a numerical semigroup, i.e. a submonoid of $(\mathbb{N},+)$ containing $0$ with finite complement in $\mathbb{N}$. Write $\Gamma = \langle n_1,\dots,n_e\rangle$ with $n_1<\cdots<n_e$ a minimal system of generators; the integer $e = \operatorname{edim}(\Gamma)$ is called the embedding dimension of $\Gamma$. The Frobenius number $\operatorname{Frob}(\Gamma)$ is the largest integer not in $\Gamma$. The semigroup $\Gamma$ is called symmetric if for every $x\in\mathbb{Z}\setminus\Gamma$ one has $\operatorname{Frob}(\Gamma)-x\in\Gamma$.

Consider the surjective monoid homomorphism $\varphi:\mathbb{N}^e\to\Gamma$ sending the $i$-th standard basis vector to $n_i$, and let $\sim_\Gamma$ be the kernel congruence $\{(\alpha,\beta)\in\mathbb{N}^e\times\mathbb{N}^e:\varphi(\alpha)=\varphi(\beta)\}$. A minimal presentation of $\Gamma$ is a generating set of $\sim_\Gamma$ (as a congruence) of minimal cardinality; all minimal presentations have the same cardinality, denoted $\rho(\Gamma)$ (the minimal number of relations needed to present $\Gamma$).

For each positive integer $e$, define
$$S(e) \;=\; \sup\bigl\{\,\rho(\Gamma)\;:\;\Gamma\text{ is a symmetric numerical semigroup with }\operatorname{edim}(\Gamma)=e\bigr\}.$$

Determine $S(e)$ as a function of $e$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem appears as an open problem in a recent (June 2024) survey/problem list "Open problems on relations of numerical semigroups" by Moscariello and Sammartano. Closed-form values of S(e) are known only for small e (e ≤ 4); the general case remains open, and no subsequent resolution was found in the search.

status_evidence.title: On the cardinality of minimal presentations of numerical semigroups
status_evidence.snippet: Studies cardinalities of minimal presentations; explicit sharp bounds for symmetric semigroups in arbitrary embedding dimension are not established in general.
status_evidence.claim: Related work without a full determination of S(e).
